transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because people keep acting like I’m making something out of nothing, but… I don’t think I am.

It’s about my father’s death. The hospital records, the donation emails—everyone says it all lines up. But when I look at the timestamps, things that should be attached but aren’t, and how certain people in the community dodge my questions… it seems pretty clear someone’s hiding what really happened.
If someone shows you evidence that your father’s death happened as reported, are you able to accept it?

I mean… if it really explained everything, maybe. But people keep saying it all lines up, and it doesn’t to me.

The timestamps, the missing attachments, the way some people avoid answering… I can’t just ignore that. It seems obvious someone’s hiding what actually happened.
Do you think it is possible that you might be mistaken about someone hiding the truth about your father’s death?

I guess anything is possible, but… no, I don’t really think I’m mistaken. When I compare the timestamps and the missing attachments, and then certain people won’t answer straight, it just looks too obvious that something’s being hidden.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people do not?
No… not really. I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Aside from your father’s death, do you believe anyone is hiding the truth from you about other parts of your life?

No… not really other parts of my life.

It’s mainly about my father’s death. People say the hospital records and donation emails all match, but when I look at the timestamps, the missing attachments, and how certain people avoid my questions… it feels pretty clear something is being kept back.
Has this situation made it hard for you to work or handle your usual day-to-day responsibilities?

Not really, no. I mean, I still go to work, keep up with my projects, pay my bills… normal stuff.

It mostly gets hard when I bring it up with family or people who knew about the records. That’s when things get tense.
If the hospital gave you complete records that fully accounted for the timestamps and missing attachments, would you believe your father died as reported?

I’d like to think so, but… honestly, I don’t know.

If everything was really complete, maybe. But it’s not just the records. It’s the timestamps, the missing attachments, and the way certain people dodge the questions. That’s what makes it hard for me to accept that nothing was hidden.
Did this belief that something was being hidden about your father’s death start soon after he died?
Yeah… pretty soon after. It’s been about nine months now, since after he died, when I started going through his records and messages.
Has this belief that something was hidden about your father’s death been present continuously for more than three months?
Yes. It’s been… about nine months, I guess. Since after my father died, when I started going through his records and messages.
Do other members of your family share your belief that something was hidden about your father’s death?

Not really. They mostly tell me the records and emails line up.

But I don’t see it that way. When I compare the timestamps, the missing attachments, and how some people avoid my questions… it feels obvious to me that something was hidden.
Has anyone shown you clear proof that your father died as reported, and you still felt certain something was being hidden?

Yes. People have shown me the records and the emails and said it all lines up. But… when I look at the timestamps, the missing attachments, and how some of the community members dodge my questions, I still feel like something’s being hidden.
Have you contacted the police or another authority because you believe your father’s death was covered up?
I’m not sure I want to get into all that. I mean… I’ve thought about it, but I don’t really have anything specific to say.
Since your father died, have you been longing for him or feeling intense grief most days?
I don’t know. I mean, I miss him, sure, but… “intense grief most days” feels like a lot to say. I haven’t really been tracking it that way.
Has this situation been causing you a lot of emotional distress?
I mean… it bothers me, yeah. I don’t know if I’d say “a lot.” Some days it gets under my skin, but I’m managing.
Do you believe for certain that your father’s death was covered up?

I mean… yes. I don’t think it’s just in my head. People keep saying the records and emails match, but when I look at the timestamps and what’s missing, and how some people dodge my questions… it’s hard not to see it. Someone’s hiding something about what happened.
In your family or community, is it common to believe that deaths like your father’s may be hidden or covered up?
I’m not sure. I mean, I wouldn’t say it’s some common belief or anything. People talk, I guess, but… I don’t really know how to answer that.
Since your father died, have you felt a strong longing or yearning for him nearly every day?
I don’t know… nearly every day sounds like a lot. I miss him, sure. But I don’t really keep track of it like that.
Has this belief about your father’s death caused you to pull away from family or friends?

A little, I guess. I mean, I haven’t really stopped working or anything—my job’s been mostly the same. But with family… some of them kind of avoid getting into it with me now, because they know I might bring up the records or what I think was covered up.
Even if every record about your father’s death were explained, would you still believe there was a cover-up?

I think… yes. I know people keep saying the records and the emails all line up, but when I look at the timestamps and the missing attachments, it doesn’t feel settled. And the way some people avoid answering me… it just seems obvious someone’s hiding something.
Do you believe something impossible happened in connection with your father’s death, such as that he is still alive despite the records?

No… I’m not saying he’s still alive or anything like that. It’s more that the records and the donation emails don’t fully add up to me. The timestamps, the missing attachments, and how some people dodge my questions… it makes it feel obvious that something was hidden about what really happened.
